checkFailed: Could not check for updates. Try again later.
downloadFailed: The download did not finish. Try again.
noNotes: This version has no release notes.
notesTruncated: The notes are long and were cut off; the full text is on GitHub.
sendingBlocksRestart: A message is still being sent; restart once it has gone.
installUnavailable: This installation cannot update itself. Download the new version from GitHub, or use the package manager you installed MailX with.
autoUpdateDescription: Automatically download updates, then remind you to restart or install when you quit. MailX never restarts automatically. Checks continue when this is off.
installFailed: The update could not be installed. Retry to prepare it again, or download the installer from GitHub.
